name: wing-rack-mcp
description: Controls a Behringer WING - full size, Compact or Rack - over OSC on the LAN. No credentials: the desk is unauthenticated UDP. The command profile is generated off the hardware and chosen by the model the desk reports (ngc-full, wing-compact, wing-rack); the bundle ships the Rack's and wing_generate_profile builds one for any other desk. Destructive, transport, scene-recall and network-identity addresses are excluded from the writable set and unreachable from any tool. Every write is read back and compared. Pushes, dumps and profile walks run as background jobs polled with wing_job_status. Includes live meters, RTA, gain staging, fades, a live change feed, presets, auto-gate/compress and opt-in scene control. Model catalog derived from libwing (Apache-2.0).

tools.name: verify_connection
tools.description: Health check. Server version, connected desk and model, the profile in use and every profile available.

tools.name: wing_list_consoles
tools.description: Every WING answering on the network: console name, address, model, serial, firmware.

tools.name: wing_connect
tools.description: Connect to a desk by console name, never by address. Refuses a name two desks share.

tools.name: wing_get
tools.description: Read one or more nodes: current values, read-only flags, legal ranges and child nodes.

tools.name: wing_find
tools.description: Search the profile for commands by words in their address, with type, range and writability.

tools.name: wing_set
tools.description: Write named parameters to one node. Whole-message validation, read-back after every write, staged model changes.

tools.name: wing_set_many
tools.description: Several validated writes in one call; nothing is sent if any fails validation.

tools.name: wing_dump
tools.description: Read a subtree to a show file; large walks continue in the background.

tools.name: wing_push_file
tools.description: Push a complete show file as a background job and return a job id immediately. No confirm token. Retries the whole push up to three times on failure; one push at a time, never queued.

tools.name: wing_push_status
tools.description: Poll a background push: state, nodes done against total, elapsed seconds, a running failure count, and the report file's path.

tools.name: wing_generate_profile
tools.description: Walk the connected desk in the background and build its own command profile. Run once on a full WING or Compact, and after any firmware change.

tools.name: wing_job_status
tools.description: Poll any background job - push, dump or profile walk.

tools.name: wing_meters
tools.description: Live levels per strip from the desk's meter stream: input/output peaks, gate and compressor gain reduction.

tools.name: wing_rta
tools.description: The desk's 120-band RTA on one strip, pre- or post-EQ, with stand-out resonances.

tools.name: wing_gain_check
tools.description: Soundcheck gain staging in one call: preamp for coarse moves, channel trim for fine smoothing, looped until in range, fader compensated.

tools.name: wing_models
tools.description: Every EQ, gate, dynamics, filter and FX model and its controls, including models not loaded on the desk (catalog from libwing, fw 3.0.5).

tools.name: wing_fade
tools.description: Smooth timed moves of faders, sends or any level: absolute or relative, linear-in-dB or S-curve, several at once.

tools.name: wing_fade_status
tools.description: Fades currently running.

tools.name: wing_fade_stop
tools.description: Stop a fade where it is, or all of them.

tools.name: wing_watch
tools.description: Turn the live change feed on or off (uses the desk's single OSC event subscription).

tools.name: wing_changes
tools.description: What changed on the desk recently, and whether this server or someone else changed it.

tools.name: wing_preset_save
tools.description: Save part of the desk (a strip, an EQ, a bus) as a named preset on this computer.

tools.name: wing_preset_list
tools.description: Saved presets.

tools.name: wing_preset_load
tools.description: Recall a preset, optionally onto other channels (copy or move strips).

tools.name: wing_auto_gate
tools.description: Gate thresholds from measured noise floor and playing level (two steps).

tools.name: wing_auto_compress
tools.description: Compressor thresholds for a target gain reduction from measured levels.

tools.name: wing_scene_status
tools.description: Open show, active scene and scene list.

tools.name: wing_scene
tools.description: Scene recall (GO/NEXT/PREV/GOTAG). Off unless enabled in ~/.wing-mcp/config.json.

tools.name: wing_audio_check
tools.description: Check (and optionally install) what USB audio analysis needs and find the WING's USB audio device.

tools.name: wing_loudness
tools.description: Stream loudness (EBU R128): integrated LUFS, short-term, loudness range, true peak, vs a target.

tools.name: wing_loudness_monitor
tools.description: Background loudness meter on a bus for a whole service.

tools.name: wing_loudness_status
tools.description: Read the running loudness meter.

tools.name: wing_polarity_check
tools.description: Polarity and arrival-time difference between two mics on one source; can set invert/delay.

tools.name: wing_feedback_find
tools.description: Precise ringing frequencies with suggested notches; can apply one to an EQ band.

tools.name: wing_pa_measure
tools.description: Dual-FFT PA measurement at a mic position: response, phase, coherence, arrival, room reverb. Programme or the desk's pink noise.

tools.name: wing_pa_list
tools.description: Saved PA measurements.

tools.name: wing_pa_report
tools.description: Response vs a target curve, trust (coherence) and biggest issues.

tools.name: wing_pa_average
tools.description: Coherence-weighted average of several positions.

tools.name: wing_pa_eq
tools.description: Fit a cut-preferring parametric EQ to the target; apply with backup.

tools.name: wing_pa_align
tools.description: Delay and polarity between two parts of the PA (mains/subs/fills); can apply output delay.

tools.name: wing_pa_room
tools.description: Room acoustics per octave (ISO 3382): EDT, T20, T30, C50, C80, D50.
